description: Stop a background service managed by the package manager's service supervisor. The adapter first confirms the service's package is installed (issuing the metadata query and checking for a non-empty installed set). When installed, it issues two supervisor commands in order: a plain stop followed by a privileged stop. When the package is not installed, no supervisor commands are issued. The output echoes the installed-check query followed by any supervisor commands in the exact order issued.

cases.expected_output:
cmd=brew info php@8.1 --json
cmd=brew services stop php@8.1
cmd=sudo brew services stop php@8.1
